title: evident — supernova

phrases.translation: 不言而喻的；不证自明的

sentences.sentence: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
sentences.translation: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

sentences.sentence: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
sentences.translation: 我开车出了大门，经过看门人的门房。

sentences.sentence: These antibodies work against the measles virus.
sentences.translation: 这些抗体有对抗麻疹病毒作用。

sentences.sentence: This is why many viruses, such as measles, make us ill only once.
sentences.translation: 这就是为什么许多病毒，如麻疹，只会使我们生病一次。

sentences.sentence: Imagine if we have an outbreak of measles and the information is relayed to us three months after the outbreak.
sentences.translation: 想像一下如果我们已经爆发了麻疹，而消息是在爆发后的三个月后才传到我们这里。

sentences.sentence: We humans appear to be meaning-seeking creatures that have the misfortune to be thrown into a world devoid of intrinsic meaning.
sentences.translation: 我们人类似乎是寻求意义的生物，而很不幸，我们却进入了一个本质上缺乏意义的世界。

sentences.sentence: Rice cakes may seem like a good option – after all they're fat-free and low in calories – but they're also devoid of fibre and protein and can make you crave something more satisfying.
sentences.translation: 大米蛋糕似乎是好的选择-毕竟它们无脂肪，低卡路里-但是它们也缺乏纤维和蛋白质，会使你渴望更令人满意的东西。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 222 单元

evident
音标：英 /'evɪdənt/  美 /'ɛvɪdənt/
adj.  明显的， 清楚的
短语：self evident — 不言而喻的；不证自明的
例句：Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

lodge
音标：英 /lɑːdʒ/  美 /lɑdʒ/
n.  房子， 住处
短语：lodge a claim — 提出索赔
短语：lodge a complaint — 投诉；对…提出控告
例句：I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
我开车出了大门，经过看门人的门房。

measles
音标：英 /'miːzlz/  美 /'mizəlz/
n.  麻疹
短语：measles vaccine — n. [免疫学]麻疹疫苗；麻疹
短语：measles virus — [医]麻疹病毒
短语：german measles — [医]风疹（又称德国麻疹）
例句：These antibodies work against the measles virus.
这些抗体有对抗麻疹病毒作用。
例句：This is why many viruses, such as measles, make us ill only once.
这就是为什么许多病毒，如麻疹，只会使我们生病一次。
例句：Imagine if we have an outbreak of measles and the information is relayed to us three months after the outbreak.
想像一下如果我们已经爆发了麻疹，而消息是在爆发后的三个月后才传到我们这里。

devoid
音标：英 /dɪ'vɔɪd/  美 /dɪ'vɔɪd/
adj.  空的， 缺乏的
短语：devoid of — 没有；缺乏的
例句：We humans appear to be meaning-seeking creatures that have the misfortune to be thrown into a world devoid of intrinsic meaning.
我们人类似乎是寻求意义的生物，而很不幸，我们却进入了一个本质上缺乏意义的世界。
例句：Rice cakes may seem like a good option – after all they're fat-free and low in calories – but they're also devoid of fibre and protein and can make you crave something more satisfying.
大米蛋糕似乎是好的选择-毕竟它们无脂肪，低卡路里-但是它们也缺乏纤维和蛋白质，会使你渴望更令人满意的东西。

音标：英 /pɑːr'tɪkjələt/  美 /pɚ'tɪkjə,let/

我们告诉你，不只那些（有形体）上满布着生命体，而且行星、星体和空间微粒之间也满布着有意识的存有。
例句：But studies have shown that high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters on most jets today can capture 99.97% of bacterial and virus-carrying particles.
但研究表明，如今大部分飞机上的高效微粒空气过滤器能够滤掉99.97%的细菌和病毒微粒。
例句：...the particulate pollution in our atmosphere.
